$comment: The grants the email sender's tables need (migrations/20261121194000_email_sender.sql; ARCHITECTURE §9.4, §9.5; spec 08 §4.2, §4.3), beside P0-E's `email` fragment (packages/db/roles/grants/email.json), which holds the schemas (email, and email_private, which only the worker and email.enqueue()'s owner may use), email.enqueue() and the outbox. The sender's tables live with the outbox in email_private, so no other login can name (and so lock) them. Only the worker reads the grants, counts, budgets and bucket. INSERT on the bucket and on the delivery check's turn lets the worker put back their rows after a restore; UPDATE on the turn's row is what lets the worker take the delivery check's turn (a row lock).
